Canon Formation in the Age of AI: a text included in a training set is amplified beyond non-included texts (O-class, membership of a work in a training set). Candidate O0016
The leesharks Datasets on Hugging Face: uptake into a training corpus is the uptaking system's own act (O-class). Candidates O0350, O0351
